text:
Morgan: Alert from Support  customer acme-analytics: p99 text-gen latency spikes + intermittent GPU OOMs starting ~13:50 UTC. Ticket includes logs and sample long sessions.
Ashley: acknowledging. Any recent runtime/kernel/alloc changes on pool-7? @DeployBot can you dump recent rollouts for pool-7?
DeployBot: roll history (pool-7, 48h): 1964980000 runtime v1.14.1, 1964998000 monitoring agent update, 1965002000 kernel/driver tweak (memory allocator params). No KV config flips.
Lin: metrics pulled. Notable signals: GPU overall utilization moderate, but contiguous free segments low. Per-session KV blowup correlates to a handful of heavy sessions. Snapshot: 

metric: gpu_mem_used_percent p50=58 p95=86 p99=91
metric: gpu_free_contiguous_mb p50=11000 p95=1900 p99=300
metric: kv_cache_bytes_per_session p95=6.1GB p99=10.7GB

Symptoms: runtime requests large cudaMallocs, sometimes failing -> runtime falls back to host-path allocations -> token emission rate drops and p99 spikes.
Sofia: found runtime log lines: 

```
E 13:51:08 cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (alloc size: 6.2GB)
W 13:51:09 runtime: fallback to host allocator, token emission slowed
I 13:51:09 kv: session sess-8422 kv.size=11.2GB
```

Morgan: support repro shows many long-running chats with continual system+user appends; single session context lengths >24k tokens, which explains sustained KV growth.
Ricardo: need to confirm fragmentation vs real exhaustion. `nvidia-smi` shows free memory but allocator fails on large contiguous requests. That indicates fragmentation.
Lin: NVML memory info shows free total memory but `gpu_free_contiguous_mb` metric low. Our internal allocator requires large contiguous chunks for certain tensors and for KV buffer growth.
Ashley: immediate mitigations we can enable remotely with low risk: 
- per-tenant soft limit: runtime.flag kv.max_per_session_bytes=4GB (returns soft-eviction events)
- enable kv.compress_prefix=true to reduce per-token bytes for repeated prefixes
- short-term enforcement: 429 for requests that propose context >10k tokens (support-approved)
- schedule rolling graceful restarts to coalesce freed GPU memory and clear fragmentation

Sofia: alternative runbook items: experimental jemalloc tweaks to encourage larger contiguous allocations: MALLOC_CONF=\"oversize_threshold:0,lg_chunk:21\" on A/B nodes. We'll only apply to non-prod first.
Ricardo: I drafted restart playbook: 
1) cordon node from LB; 2) wait max 35s for inflight token emission to finish; 3) stop runtime processes; 4) verify no process using CUDA contexts (nvidia-smi shows 0 processes); 5) restart runtime and confirm contiguous free regained; 6) uncordon.
OperationsBot: scheduled rolling restarts for pool-7 at 14:10 UTC, stagger 60s, 6 nodes.
Lin: repro script for staging to reproduce fragmentation (do not run against prod): 

```
# frag-repro.sh
for i in $(seq 1 100); do
  curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.staging.redwood/v1/generate \\
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\
    -d '{\"session_id\":\"sess-'$i'\",\"input\":\"'$(python - <<'PY'\nprint(' '.join(['tok']*14000))\nPY
)'\"}' &
done
wait
```

On our mini-pool this produces cudaMalloc failures in ~8-12m. Use with caution.
Ashley: diagnostics to collect pre-restart: `/proc/<pid>/maps`, `pmap -x <pid>`, `je-alloc-stats` (if jemalloc), `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY`, runtime logs around kv.gc/kv.evict, kernel dmesg. Post-restart collect same metrics and compare.
Sofia: toggled kv.compress_prefix=true on pool-7 via feature flag at 14:11 UTC (safe toggle). Also flipped per-tenant kv.max_per_session_bytes=4GB for acme-analytics.
Morgan: also propose a support throttle: reject any single request >10240 tokens with 429 + guidance link to KB. Support concurred.
Ricardo: after node-2 restart, contiguous free before restart ~520MB, post-restart contiguous free ~24.6GB. Host regained baseline latency within ~70-100s.
Lin: observed p99 on that host fall from 2.9s -> 0.38s. OOM logs ceased for that host.
Ashley: customer confirmed improvement on their side; they accepted recommendation to shard lengthy histories and to use summarization to reduce KV size.
Sofia: proposed engineering follow-ups (owner & ETA): 
- implement kv_fragmentation_ratio metric + alerting (owner: Sofia, ETA: 10d)
- add slab-like allocator for KV buffers to reduce external fragmentation (owner: Lin, ETA: 3w prototype)
- auto-evict when contiguous_free_mb < threshold or fragmentation_ratio > 0.7 (owner: Lin, ETA: 2w)
- default soft per-session limit (2GB) with telemetry and opt-outs for enterprise (owner: Ashley for policy, ETA: 1w)
Ricardo: infra follow-ups: evaluate jemalloc MALLOC_CONF defaults and safe rollout plan (owner: Ricardo, ETA: 7d). Also validate driver/kernel settings after recent kernel tweak (1965002000).
Morgan: incident created INC-1962 (Sofia). Severity: P2. Attach repro job, logs, and restart timeline.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-1962 created by Sofia. Severity: P2. Link: ticket/INC-1962

(15:05) Lin: rolling restarts completed for all pool-7 nodes. Aggregate p99 across pool-7 dropped from median 2.6s -> 0.5s. cudaMalloc OOM counts reduced to zero post-restart.
(15:20) Ashley: patching support KB now: steps to recommend sharding, summary windows, and how to request higher per-session limits for enterprise customers.
(15:36) Morgan: recap + owners: 
- Sofia: kv_fragmentation telemetry & alert (ETA 10d)
- Lin: slab allocator prototype + auto-evict (ETA 2-3w)
- Ricardo: jemalloc safe defaults validation (ETA 7d)
- Ashley: customer communication & KB (ETA next business day)

Sofia: saving the repro job to CI: ci-job=rn-gpu-kv-frag-test. Link added to INC-1962.
Morgan: thanks everyone. Good cross-team ops. :thumbsup: Last update 15:40 UTC.
